pins.headline: Goals that last past February
pins.sub: Weekly steps, pace tracking and a Sunday check-in.
pins.title: 2027 Goal Planner App: Set Goals That Actually Last Past February
pins.description: Most new year's resolutions fade by February. This 2027 goal planner app turns each goal into weekly steps, shows whether you're ahead or behind pace, and gives you a 5-minute Sunday check-in to stay on track. Includes a new year reset with year in review questions, wheel of life, word of the year, vision board, habit tracker and bucket list. Works on phone and computer, offline and private.
pins.alt: Three phones showing a purple goal planner app: a goal with a journey path, a Today screen with goals on track, and a wheel of life radar chart.

pins.headline: 5 habits for resolutions that stick
bullets: Write down why the goal matters
Break every goal into small steps
Pick a top 3 for each week
Check in for 5 minutes on Sunday
pins.title: 5 Habits of People Who Actually Keep Their New Year's Resolutions
pins.description: Want this year's resolutions to stick? Write down why each goal matters, break it into small steps, pick a top 3 for every week, check in for 5 minutes each Sunday and track your habits, not just results. This 2027 goal planner app is built around all five, with a journey path for every goal and a pace tracker that tells you if you're on track.
pins.alt: A checklist of five tips for keeping new year's resolutions above a phone showing a goal planner app.

pins.headline: Your new year reset checklist
pins.sub: Reflect, score your life, choose a word, set 3 goals.
pins.title: New Year Reset Checklist: Year in Review Questions, Word of the Year and Goal Setting
pins.description: Do a real new year reset before you set goals. Answer 10 guided year in review questions, write your top 3 wins, score your wheel of life, choose a word of the year and then set 3 goals. This planner app walks you through each step with a reset checklist, then turns your goals into weekly steps you can actually follow.
pins.alt: Two phones: a reset checklist with the word of the year BLOOM, and year in review reflection questions.

pins.headline: How balanced is your life?
pins.sub: Score 8 areas from 1 to 10 and see your wheel of life.
pins.title: Wheel of Life Exercise: Score 8 Areas of Your Life (Free Self-Check Idea)
pins.description: The wheel of life is a simple self-check: score health, money, career, relationships, growth, fun, home and mind from 1 to 10, then look at which area needs the most love. This goal planner app draws your wheel as a radar chart, compares it with last time and lets you add a goal for your lowest area in one tap.
pins.alt: A phone showing a wheel of life radar chart with scores for 8 life areas on a dark purple card.

pins.headline: A 2027 vision board on your phone
pins.sub: Photos, dreams and quotes you'll actually see every day.
pins.title: Digital Vision Board 2027 Ideas: Make One on Your Phone
pins.description: A vision board works best when you see it every day. Make a 2027 vision board on your phone with your own photos, dream cards and favorite quotes, plus your word of the year. It's part of a goal planner app that turns those dreams into goals and weekly steps. Photos stay private on your device.
pins.alt: A phone showing a colorful digital vision board with dream cards and quotes below the word of the year.
